collection.title: Renault Megane Cabrio 1997 to 2003 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Renault Megane Cabrio 1997 to 2003 will fit, this model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade
